messages:
jeff: Quick flag  Caspian LoRA merge (v0.5) failing numeric-format checks after int4 quant. Small triage please.

maya: Can you paste a failing case and quant recipe?

jeff: Example: 
```
input: "Total due: $45,678.90"
expected: "$45,678.90"
int4-output: "45678.90 dollars"
```

sam: Which quant builder? GPTQ-4bit. Tokenizer v16. FP16 baseline passes so it looks quant/tokenizer related.

jeff: quickpack summary: 100 tests, 2 fails, both thousands-separator collapse. Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-test-results/caspian/3965000000/summary.json

eval-bot: quick-eval logged: 100/98 passed  2 failures  see artifacts. :warning:

maya: Short mitigations: 1) add failing prompts to the customer's regression pack; 2) gate a token pre-split for digit-comma-digit during packaging for gptq/awq when client=caspian; 3) route invoice-like traffic to fp16 temporarily.

sam: I'll try a tiny packaging tweak: insert zero-width separator between digits and commas before tokenization and run quickpack locally. Command: 
```
./ci/run_quickpack.sh --client caspian --adapter lora/caspian-v0.5 --base cascade-base --quant gptq-4bit --patch digit-comma-split --prompts tests/caspian_money.jsonl
```

pkg-bot: patch PR opened: infra/quant/patches#821 author=sam title="pre-tokenize: split digit-comma for caspian"

sam: Local run with patch: quickpack 100/100 pass. Will push canary flag-gated to dedicated canary pool.

maya: Add monitoring: money-format correctness >99.9%, tokenization-diff alert. If canary clean, promote and remove fp16 fallback.

eval-bot: regression suite updated: tests/caspian_money.jsonl +2 blocker examples added.

jeff: Thanks team, will follow-up with canary link and final signoff.
